description: This file defines a class 'reschedule_count' with a method 'count' that counts call attempts for display in a list view within a CRM module. It includes a requirement for an external PHP file related to call reschedule history and invokes a function 'reschedule_count'.

classes.name: reschedule_count
classes.description: A class responsible for counting rescheduled calls or call attempts, meant to be used within the CRM's calls module for display purposes.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of call attempts for a focus object, required in a list view context. It loads related reschedule history and calls a global function to perform the count.
